max_copies.triple: buy a third copy only when it makes a golden

birds_homecoming.save_rule: Spend out every turn. The one save: on the turn before a scheduled tier-up, keep what next turn's discounted tier cost needs beyond next turn's income. With Mrs Stork in play, spend any leftover on refreshes; her count carries over, so no 6-gold blocks are needed.

fly_policy.who: every flier that has fought at home since it was played; Mother Goose first, then biggest first
fly_policy.old_tern: fly only with 2 or more Birds away
fly_policy.omen_turn: if seven different Birds including seven_whistlers can stand on the board this turn, fly nothing
fly_policy.elimination_guard: don't fly the biggest Bird when Health is 2x the round's likely loss or less

birds_homecoming.great_lump_seat: End of Turn: the Nest of the biggest Bird away
birds_homecoming.golden_egg: the biggest Bird without an Egg; hold it while that Bird is away; play it at End of Turn if that Bird isn't due home next turn
birds_homecoming.placement: seven_whistlers across the scouted biggest enemy, jack_daw across the second biggest, mag_pye across the enemy with the best text; back row: the biggest Bird, then tom_tit, gabble_ratchet, mr_redbreast, mrs_stork; Eggs and the rest in the front row

max_copies.triple: buy a third copy only when it makes a golden

birds_tempo.save_rule: Spend out every turn; the one save is the turn before a scheduled tier-up, as in birds_homecoming.

fly_policy.who: Chiffchaff and One Swallow only, until the switch round; never mrs_jay before it
